item.title: Electron‐Deficient Destabilization Coupled With Mg‐philic Catalysis: A Dual‐Modulation Strategy for Low‐Temperature Dehydrogenation of Mg(BH 4 ) 2
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a dual-modulation strategy coupling electron-deficient boron-doped graphene with Mg-philic Nb catalysts to destabilize Mg(BH₄)₂. It achieves record-low dehydrogenation temperatures (onset 50°C) and reduced activation energies, while suppressing byproduct accumulation for enhanced cyclability. This offers a promising design paradigm for advanced hydrogen storage materials.
🏷 hydrogen storage · Mg(BH4)2 · dehydrogenation · Mg-philic catalysis · boron-doped graphene

item.title: Entropy‐Engineered Topological Relaxor States in Lead‐Free Ferroelectric Superlattices for High‐Performance Capacitive Energy Storage
item.description:
مهندسی آنتروپی در ابرشبکه‌های فروالکتریک بدون سرب، حالت‌های ریلکسور توپولوژیکی را تثبیت و ذخیره‌سازی انرژی خازنی را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers entropy-engineered topological relaxor states in lead-free Na0.5Bi0.5TiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices, overcoming the polarization-dilution bottleneck of conventional ferroelectric/paraelectric designs. By transforming vortices into topological relaxors via local random fields, it flattens energy barriers, enabling thinner paraelectric layers, low hysteresis, and high polarization. Structural fluctuations also boost breakdown resistance, offering a practical framework for high-performance lead-free capacitive energy storage.
🏷 capacitive energy storage · ferroelectric superlattices · entropy engineering · topological relaxor · lead-free

item.title: Quantifying electronic insulation of solid-electrolyte interphases through electrolyte decomposition kinetics
item.description:
این مقاله با بررسی سینتیک تجزیه الکترولیت، عایق‌بودن الکترونیکی لایه بین‌فازی الکترولیت جامد (SEI) را کمّی می‌کند که برای عملکرد باتری‌های لیتیوم-یون حیاتی است.
npj Computational Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces RED, a computational framework combining Marcus theory and constrained DFT to quantify SEI electronic insulation via electrolyte decomposition kinetics. Unlike prior methods focused solely on electronic coupling, RED integrates reorganization energy, revealing that it can reverse insulation rankings. This enables component-resolved, electrolyte-dependent evaluation, identifying Li2CO3's high insulation and establishing a proof-of-concept for studying heterogeneous SEIs.

item.title: Ferroelectric Low‐Tortuosity Separators for Dendrite‐Free Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Ferroelectric BaTiO₃-coated track-etched membranes with vertically aligned, low-tortuosity channels are introduced as separators for solid-state lithium metal batteries. Combined with in situ polymerized PDOL, they shorten Li⁺ pathways and homogenize electric fields, enabling dendrite-free plating, high conductivity (0.12 mS cm⁻¹), and stable cycling. This geometrically engineered ferroelectric separator paradigm advances safe, high-performance lithium metal batteries.
